question: Should OpenClaw accept read-scoped runtime-config drift path names and per-cache-hit disk snapshot reads as the health diagnostic contract for this PR?
rationale: The patch is additive, tested, and proof-backed, but the auth-adjacent visibility boundary and health RPC freshness cost are product and operations choices that automated review cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
options.body: Land after final maintainer review because redaction is tested, the diff is additive, and the supplied terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health path behavior.

options.title: Request Extra Privacy Or Latency Proof
options.body: Ask for a read-vs-admin transcript or health latency sample before merge if maintainers are not comfortable with drift path visibility or per-cache-hit disk reads.

options.title: Pause For Companion Policy PR
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers decide diagnostics and the hot-mode restart-policy PR must be reviewed or landed together.

recommendation.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after final maintainer review because redaction is tested, the diff is additive, and the supplied terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health path behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` is the strongest current-main owner signal for the health cache merge and health payload shape this PR extends.
